answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed if its attestations prove false, like a falcon that must risk its own perch before it can hunt over the meadow. New identities start with low weight, so creating thousands of clones costs real capital for each one and yields no extra influence until they build a verifiable history. Honest agents earn an opal badge of cumulative good work, while a sybil farm that misbehaves loses deposits across all its identities at once, making the attack more expensive than any reward it could extract.
